description: Ask AnyForge to investigate a repository question for another engineering agent. Select one to five repositories exactly as returned by anyforge_list_repo_index. AnyForge runs a bounded, read-only investigator over the selected repositories' indexed code graph, semantic code search, and analyzed-codebase docs, then returns a concise evidence-backed report with index provenance. It does not expose raw graph records, live source, connected systems, or write tools. Use this when the caller needs repository intelligence without making the Oracle the intermediary. An investigation can take a couple of minutes, so this call waits up to ~40s: if the result has status "done" it carries the report; if it has status "running", call anyforge_get_repository_investigation with its jobId (repeat while it stays "running"). Do NOT call anyforge_investigate_repository again for the same question - that starts a second investigation. Requires read scope.

context.description: Optional investigation context, such as an incident symptom, ticket id, or suspected component.

question.description: The complete repository question, including the bug, symbols, behavior, or path to investigate.

repos.description: One to five repo full names (owner/name), exactly as returned by anyforge_list_repo_index.

name: anyforge_investigate_repository
title: Investigate repository
